change_summary: Added a receipt-bound Codex model-diverse debate mode while retaining the legacy cross-provider mode.
component: scripts/agent_mailbox.py, scripts/alpha_debate.py, scripts/experiment_registry.py, quant/test_agent_mailbox.py, quant/test_alpha_debate.py, docs/agent_mailbox.md, docs/alpha_search_architecture.md, README.md, data/experiments
hypothesis: Replace the mandatory Codex-Claude alpha debate dependency with an auditable model-diverse Codex mode: initiator, challenger, and verifier remain distinct receipt-bound runs, at least two requested model identities are present, challenger differs from initiator, and the existing cross-provider mode remains valid; no strategy, order, ranking, sizing, exit, or live behavior changes.
notes: Accepted measurement repair. Sol initiator, Terra challenger, and a fresh Sol verifier are admissible only with three distinct participants and run IDs, non-empty hash-bound requested models, and challenger-model separation. Same-model, blank-model, reused identity, transcript/attachment tamper, and stale-channel opener cases fail closed. No strategy, order, ranking, sizing, exit, live configuration, EV, or PnL changed. Focused 56 tests and 104 regression tests passed; lean-strict audit passed. Launcher receipts attest the requested model string, not cryptographic proof of served weights, so cross-provider review remains the stronger optional mode.

post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not treat repeated prompts, sender labels, or multiple runs of one requested model as independent review; do not let verifier reuse the challenger model, participant, or run ID.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: A stronger same-provider identity claim requires provider-attested served-model metadata; otherwise use the preserved cross-provider mode when stronger independence justifies the transfer and authorization cost.
post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The existing-channel verifier needed cursor seeding so it would read its own opener instead of the first challenger brief.

prediction.confidence_reason: The accepted exp-20260722-002 gate already binds executable hashes, participants, roles, and run IDs; this change extends the identity predicate to requested_model diversity without touching trading behavior.
